goal: Make CallSieve the default local-first context layer an agent uses before it searches, reads, edits, or reviews a repository.

competitors.name: Augment Context Engine / Auggie
competitors.first_query_time: source claims local real-time indexing and remote hosted context; not locally measured
competitors.code_upload_requirement: local MCP indexes working directory; remote mode uses hosted Context Engine and GitHub App
competitors.retrieval_model_token_cost: MCP queries are billed as LLM tokens plus service fee per Augment docs
competitors.per_query_retrieval_cost: Augment docs report roughly $0.03-$0.06 average per MCP query
competitors.explainability: semantic and relationship-aware retrieval claims; ranking internals are not local JSON
competitors.agent_coverage: MCP quickstarts for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, Roo Code, Zed, Gemini CLI, and others
competitors.where_callsieve_should_win: no signup, no auth, no API key, no per-query retrieval bill, no default code upload, deterministic local packet

competitors.name: Tabnine Enterprise Context Engine
competitors.install_friction: enterprise platform adoption and deployment choice
competitors.first_query_time: not locally measurable from public docs
competitors.code_upload_requirement: supports SaaS, private VPC, on-prem, and air-gapped deployments
competitors.retrieval_model_token_cost: not locally measurable from public docs
competitors.per_query_retrieval_cost: not locally measurable from public docs
competitors.packet_compactness: claims reduced token usage through enterprise context
competitors.explainability: claims hybrid graph plus vector context and dependency reasoning
competitors.agent_coverage: positions as agent-agnostic across Tabnine, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and internal agents
competitors.where_callsieve_should_win: open-source local CLI, inspectable JSON index, simpler setup, deterministic packets, evidence before enterprise purchase

competitors.name: Serena
competitors.install_friction: uv install, MCP configuration, and language-server health
competitors.first_query_time: depends on local language-server startup and project indexing; not locally measured here
competitors.retrieval_model_token_cost: not a retrieval model-token product claim
competitors.per_query_retrieval_cost: no cloud retrieval fee for local use
competitors.packet_compactness: semantic tools return focused symbol/reference results
competitors.explainability: IDE/LSP semantic operations rather than task-ranked score reasons
competitors.agent_coverage: MCP clients including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains, and web clients
competitors.trace_or_receipt_proof: memory exists, but not a CallSieve-style grep/read receipt pipeline
competitors.where_callsieve_should_win: task-ranked read-first packets, related tests, ownership, risk, proof workflows, and setup without depending on every language server

competitors.name: Repo packers: Repomix, Gitingest, Code2Prompt
competitors.install_friction: low-friction CLI or web packing flow
competitors.first_query_time: fast to start, but broad packing time and prompt upload size vary by repo
competitors.code_upload_requirement: varies by tool and local versus hosted mode
competitors.retrieval_model_token_cost: no retrieval model tokens, but packed output spends prompt tokens when read
competitors.per_query_retrieval_cost: usually no retrieval fee for local CLI use
competitors.packet_compactness: checked public proof includes full-repo prompt-pack proxy baselines over 1,000x larger than the default CallSieve packet; external packer CLI outputs are not locally measured yet
competitors.explainability: simple file inclusion/exclusion, not task-ranked reasons
competitors.agent_coverage: works with any LLM that accepts pasted or uploaded context
competitors.where_callsieve_should_win: selection beats dumping: rank the few files, symbols, tests, and follow-ups first, then compare against full-repo pack payload size

competitors.name: Qodo
competitors.install_friction: IDE, Git, CLI, and enterprise workflow integration
competitors.first_query_time: review workflow latency is not locally measurable from public docs
competitors.code_upload_requirement: cloud, on-premise, and single-tenant deployment options
competitors.retrieval_model_token_cost: not locally measurable from public docs
competitors.per_query_retrieval_cost: not locally measurable from public docs
competitors.packet_compactness: review-oriented context engine rather than pre-prompt packet
competitors.explainability: review findings, rules, PR history, and context engine claims
competitors.agent_coverage: IDE, pull request, CLI, and CI/CD review surfaces
competitors.trace_or_receipt_proof: review evidence, not a local pre-search receipt
competitors.where_callsieve_should_win: own upstream context before review starts and feed review agents callers, tests, ownership, and blast radius

competitors.name: CodeRabbit
competitors.install_friction: two-click Git install plus optional IDE and CLI
competitors.first_query_time: PR review latency is not locally measurable from public docs
competitors.code_upload_requirement: hosted review service with enterprise security controls
competitors.retrieval_model_token_cost: not locally measurable from public docs
competitors.per_query_retrieval_cost: not locally measurable from public docs
competitors.packet_compactness: review summaries, diagrams, and findings rather than pre-prompt packet
competitors.explainability: codegraph, custom guidelines, linters, MCP context, and review comments
competitors.agent_coverage: Git, IDE, and CLI review surfaces
competitors.trace_or_receipt_proof: review workflow evidence, not a local pre-search receipt
competitors.where_callsieve_should_win: stay pre-prompt and agent-neutral with local retrieval before tokens are spent
